manifestations.description: cannot sit for more than 4 hours a day
cannot stand or walk continuously for about 30 minutes to an hour
experiences pain in his back daily when he wakes up radiating down to his both legs
feels pain when bending forward or backwards

losses.description: The Plaintiff's complaint of lower back pain ... He cannot sit for more than 4 hours a day and he cannot stand or walk continuously for about 30 minutes to an hour. He experiences pain in his back daily when he wakes up radiating down to his both legs. He also feels pain when bending forward or backwards.

As the Plaintiff is suffering from serious lower back pain and he cannot sit, stand or walk for a prolonged period of time, I agree that he suffers a disadvantage in the labour market and he has difficulty in seeking re-employment.
